title: Gluten-Free Vegetarian Moussaka
subtitle: with mushrooms and rice flour bechamel
description: Layers of roasted eggplant and potato under a mushroom and tomato sauce, topped with a creamy rice flour bechamel and baked until golden.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Place the potato slices on one tray, season with salt and pepper, drizzle with a little olive oil and bake for about 40 minutes until tender and golden. Leave the oven on.

Place the eggplant slices on a plate, salt both sides and let them release liquid for about 15 minutes, then turn and leave for another 15 minutes. Pat very dry with paper towel, place on a tray, drizzle with a little olive oil and bake for about 20 minutes until browned.

Make the tomato and mushroom sauce: fry the finely chopped onion, mushrooms and chilli in 3 tbsp olive oil for 5 minutes over high heat until browned. Add the garlic and fry, stirring, for about 1 minute. Add the tomato paste and water and bring to the boil. Lower to medium, add the sage, a little salt and pepper and cook for about 10 minutes until thickened.

Make the bechamel: melt the butter in a heavy-based pan, add the rice flour and stir for 4 to 5 minutes over medium heat until combined and lightly golden. Add the cinnamon stick and slowly pour in the milk, stirring, until thick, smooth and creamy. Season with salt, pepper and a little nutmeg, and remove the cinnamon stick.

Raise the oven to 210°C. Lay half the eggplant slices tightly in a deep baking dish, top with a tight layer of potato, then pour over the tomato and mushroom sauce to cover completely. Sprinkle with the kashkaval and finish with a tight layer of the remaining eggplant. Pour the bechamel evenly over the top.
Bake for 40 minutes until golden. Rest for about 15 minutes before cutting.
